services.name: Ladies Comedy Night
services.desc: Get ready for Ladies Comedy Night, featuring two powerhouse comedians bringing their hilarious takes on dating, relationships, marriage, motherhood, family, and everyday life to The Broadway Theatre of Pitman! Liz Miele is a NYC-based comedian who has appeared on Comedy Central, FOX, AXS TV, Hulu, NPR’s Wait Wait… Don’t Tell Me! and CBS’s After Midnight. Her stand-up has earned millions of views across YouTube, Instagram and TikTok, with viral jokes including “Feminist Sex Positions,” “Dating Is Harder for Comedians” and “F*ck Finland.” Liz regularly tours internationally and has released several acclaimed comedy specials, including Emotionally Exhausting, Self Help Me, Ghost of Academic
